description: Access Octus' verified credit intelligence directly in Claude and other LLMs. The Octus MCP Connector™ delivers proprietary intel, issuer fundamentals, private data room documents and covenant analysis across 95%+ of the sub-investment grade credit universe. Query permissioned content in real time using natural language, power autonomous agent workflows and ground your AI systems in a trusted, standardized data source. Built for investment managers, banks, law firms and advisors who need research-grade answers at the speed of the market.
